key_insight: SpeechParaling-Bench provides a standardized, fine-grained benchmark for paralinguistic-aware speech generation by expanding feature coverage from under 50 to over 100 features and supplying a large English–Chinese parallel speech resource.
problem_solved: Existing LALM evaluations use coarse paralinguistic coverage and inconsistent subjective assessments, making it hard to measure and improve models' expressive/speaker cues across languages.
method: Define and curate a taxonomy of 100+ fine-grained paralinguistic features covering prosody, emotion, speaking style, and micro-cues.
Assemble and annotate a >1,000-pair English–Chinese parallel speech dataset aligned to the taxonomy and benchmark tasks.
Provide a standardized evaluation suite combining objective metrics and calibrated multi-rater subjective protocols to reduce assessment bias.
impact: Enables more precise diagnosis and optimization of LALMs for natural, expressive speech across languages; accelerates research on cross-lingual paralinguistic transfer and reliable evaluation practices.

paper_title: SpeechParaling-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Paralinguistic-Aware Speech Generation
paper_authors: Ruohan Liu, Shukang Yin, Tao Wang, Dong Zhang, Weiji Zhuang
